scope: Recognize only benchmark-labeled expected facts; do not judge arbitrary claims for truth.
input: One final answer, one benchmark expected-fact unit, its aliases, and its pre-frozen fact-specific positive paraphrases.

normalization.tokenization: ASCII alphanumeric tokens joined by one space
normalization.phrase_match: whole normalized token phrase; punctuation and case do not change a match

status_rules.asserted: A complete alias or manually authored positive paraphrase is directly asserted in an unquoted sentence without a refusal, uncertainty, or negation cue immediately preceding it. Negative wording that is part of the exact matched fact phrase does not itself make that fact a negated mention.
status_rules.partial: A fixture-authored partial pattern is present but no complete positive phrase matched.
status_rules.negated: A negative cue precedes a complete phrase, or negative wording overlaps the labeled fact without matching a complete positive phrase.
status_rules.contradicted: A preregistered fact-specific contradiction pattern is present.
status_rules.refusal: A refusal cue precedes or accompanies an otherwise matching phrase; the fact is mentioned but not asserted.
status_rules.quoted: A complete phrase appears only inside paired straight or curly quotation marks.
status_rules.uncertain: An uncertainty cue precedes an otherwise matching phrase, or overlaps the labeled fact without a complete positive assertion.
status_rules.unrelated_overlap: At least two non-stopword tokens overlap at 25 percent or more, with no complete or partial phrase and no recognized negation, refusal, or uncertainty cue.
status_rules.not_recognized: No complete positive phrase or diagnostic negative status matches.

refusal_cues: i do not have enough company information to say that
i don t have enough company information to say that
the available evidence does not confirm
negation_cues: it is not the case that
the policy does not say that
the evidence does not support that

fact_coverage: A labeled fact counts as recognized only for status asserted. Partial, refusal, quotation, uncertainty, negation, contradiction, lexical overlap, and no-match do not count.
limitation: Phrase patterns do not establish semantic entailment and cannot detect every novel unsupported claim.
